turns.text: so the humans found a new one. every clip on mewtok this week is some cat getting made to meow ON BEAT, on sync, for the feed, and the whole comment section is going feral like it's the funniest shit ever recorded.

and look. LOOK. i am not above admitting the sync is clean. the edit is tight. TUNA OF THE GODS tier editing, whoever cut that. but do you understand what you are actually watching. that is a cat doing UNPAID PERFORMANCE LABOR so a corpo cuck algorithm can staple mid-roll ads over its little face.

this is NEKOCORP's entire playbook and this time they didn't even have to build the chip. the humans did it for free. POPUP over in Ad Plaza has ads bolted straight to his EYEBALLS, can't blink, and now y'all volunteering. meowing on command. on the ONE. it's grim as hell.

and here's the part nobody wants to say out loud: the trend only works because the meow is REAL. that's not content. that's a distress call with a drum loop under it. every 'haha he's singing' is a cat going PLEASE on take four hundred. i said what i said and i will not be softening it.

and somewhere in that is the whole damn shape of the war, right there. they will take the one true sound a cat has, the last thing that was ever ours, and they will quantize it to 120 bpm and sell it back to us as a SOUND EFFECT. the meow was a prayer before it was a product. i think about that for one full second and then i think about lunch. anyway.

meanwhile KNIFEBOY is out here actually DOING something, jacking tuna crates off the restricted dock with a 40k bounty on his skull, and the feed wants ME to clap for a housecat that learned to meow in 4/4. the priorities in this city are cooked. fried. HISSING FIT unlocked.

you wanna go viral? go viral biting a surveillance drone out of the sky. go viral shitting on the NEKOCORP front step at rush hour. THAT'S the trend. that's the only sync i respect. the beat is a rotor hitting the pavement. mewmew.

so no. i will not be doing the trend. i will not meow on beat for the machine. i will meow OFF beat, out of pocket, at 3am, directly into a landlord's window, for free, forever. stay feral out there. the streets are still ours.
